decisionsTitle: «Lista de invitați speciali»: the hidden list renamed, and every screen that shows it says what it does (amending §648)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-03 morning**, after BR-V2.63 reached production: «Am nevoie de mai multe explicații: la lista ascunsă nu-mi e clar ce face. Trebuie să folosim „listă de invitați speciali”, cu tooltip și iconița separată.» This amends §648's name (1) and adds the explanations; nothing else of §648 or §647 moves.

**1. The name.** «Lista ascunsă» is now **«Lista de invitați speciali»** / "Special guests list" in every word the club reads. It says what the list is for — organizers, volunteers, pacemakers and invited runners at the start without taking one of the announced places — and drops the word «ascunsă», which read as if somebody were hidden from the participants; nobody is (the public list still shows a ticked special guest like anybody, §648.6). The words: the radio «Se numără între locurile evenimentului» / «Invitat special — nu ocupă un loc» ("Counted among the event's places" / "Special guest — takes no place"); the dialogs' verbs «Pune pe lista de invitați speciali» / «Scoate de pe lista de invitați speciali»; the chip «Invitat special»; the pill «Invitați speciali: N»; the badge tooltip's and «Înscrierile primite»'s «invitați speciali: N»; the editor group «Lista de invitați speciali» with «Folosește lista de invitați speciali», «Numerele invitaților speciali încep de la» and «Numără și invitații speciali»; the refusals `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`, `HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES(_DATED)`, `HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES(_DATED)` and `SPARES_BEFORE_HIDDEN_LIST`; the dialogs' bodies («primește acum un loc ca invitat special»), the toasts and the audit label; the email invitation's tick «Pe lista de invitați speciali (nu ocupă un loc)», its help and the send dialog's line; the export's last column "Special guest" (CSV and spreadsheet — every header there is English); the guide's task «Invitați speciali: organizatori, pacemakeri, voluntari». `BUSINESS.md`'s vocabulary, `AGENTS.md` §10.5, §10.6 and §15.11, `CLAUDE.md`'s two rows and `SETUP.md` §39 say the new words; every rule is the same.

**Not renamed, on purpose:** the column `registrations.outside_capacity`, the event's `hidden_list_*` columns, the identifiers `hiddenList*` / `outsideCapacity` / `HiddenListChip` / `HiddenListRadio`, the error markers `HIDDEN_LIST_*`, the audit actions `registration.outside_capacity_changed` and `event.hidden_list_changed`, the glyph's name `hiddenList` and the list's `outside=1` parameter. Renaming code for a label is churn the public repository does not need, a column rename is a contract migration for a word, and a bookmarked filter keeps working.

**2. The explanations — touch-friendly, never hover-only.**
- *The registration page's block.* Its heading keeps the incognito glyph and gains an «i» beside it — §640's pattern (`InfoTip`, a 44-pixel button that opens on a tap and is named by its text) — with three lines, each under 200 characters (§511): «Pentru organizatori, voluntari, pacemakeri și sportivi invitați: sunt la start fără să ocupe unul dintre locurile anunțate.» «Păstrează declarația și numărul de concurs; apar pe lista publică dacă au bifat; nu intră în numărătoarea publică decât dacă bifezi la eveniment «Numără și invitații speciali».» «Un participant obișnuit nu se pune aici.» The «i» sits beside the heading, not inside it, so the radio group's accessible name stays the heading's words. The caption under the radios says the essentials in one line: «Invitat special: e la start fără să ocupe unul dintre locurile anunțate și își păstrează declarația și numărul de concurs.» The Organizer, who reads the radios disabled, reads the same «i» and caption.
- *The editor's group.* Its heading carries the same glyph. The switch's help says what ticking shows and what unticking keeps: «Bifat: pe înscrieri apare «Invitat special — nu ocupă un loc». Debifat: nimeni nou nu intră pe listă; cei de pe ea rămân, iar pagina îi anunță cât timp au loc.» Its «?» (§634's `BoxNote` `more`, four lines, each under 200 characters) says who the list is for, the two settings under the switch, and how it differs from «Invitații» by email: «O invitație pe email e felul în care cineva primește un link ca să se înscrie. Lista de invitați speciali spune doar dacă înscrierea ocupă sau nu unul dintre locurile anunțate; o invitație pe email se poate trimite și «Pe lista de invitați speciali».» (two lines, so each stays under §511's ceiling).
- *The chip and the pill.* Each carries `title` «Invitat special: nu ocupă unul dintre locurile anunțate» / "Special guest: takes none of the announced places"; the pill's link is named by its visible words, then that sentence. A plain chip is no control, so ARIA gives it no name of its own: its words and the title say it, and the registration page's «i» is the touch-friendly explanation. The invitations list's row now wears the same chip, glyph and title (it was a bare outlined word).
- *The guide.* The task's first step says who the list is for, that it is not for an ordinary participant and that it hides nobody; the other steps follow in the new words. The pill step quotes the chip «Invitat special», a label the screen shows, as the guide's own test requires.

**3. Unchanged, on purpose.** Behaviour, the allocator, the capacity formula and its one exclusion, the counts, the two number series and the spares, the switch's rules, the invitations' rules, the glyph, the Organizer's rights, the emails, and the public pages' words: «în afara locurilor anunțate», the places line's sentence and the start-list notes say what they said, and no public string says «invitați speciali», «invitat special» or "special guest" (the existing test that no public namespace names the backoffice's list now holds the new words too). No migration, no dependency.

**Refused.**
- **Renaming the code, the column and the audit actions** to match: churn, and a contract migration, for a label.
- **A hover-only tooltip** on the radio or the chip as the explanation: a phone has no hover; the «i» and the «?» open on a tap.
- **The backoffice's new name on a public page**: the public reads «în afara locurilor anunțate», as §648 decided; a public «invitat special» badge would mark a row the public list deliberately does not mark.
- **Splitting the email invitation from the list**: an invitation is how somebody gets a link; the special guests list is whether the registration takes a place. The «?» says so instead.
changelogLine: - **«Lista de invitați speciali» instead of «Lista ascunsă»** — the backoffice calls it what it is for (organizers, volunteers, pacemakers, invited runners at the start without taking an announced place); the registration's block has an «i» that explains it, the editor's switch a «?» that says how it differs from an invitation by email, and the chip and the pill a one-line hint. Nothing else changes, and the public pages keep their words. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Criterion 191 (amended): The registrations list's summary strip shows «Invitați speciali: N» with the incognito glyph, its `title` and its link's name adding «Invitat special: nu ocupă unul dintre locurile anunțate» — outlined in the default colour like every other pill, filled in the brand colour while pressed — while any real registration is on the hidden list, a link that filters the list to them (`outside=1`, kept beside the state in force, the strip's counts unchanged by it), each such row wears the «Invitat special» chip with the glyph and the same `title`, the «Înscrieri» badge's «cu loc» and confirmed figures leave them out while the tooltip's event line ends «, invitați speciali: N», the event's «Înscrierile primite» says «invitați speciali: N» beside the occupied places, and the CSV and spreadsheet end with «Special guest» and, with the pill pressed (`outside=1`), hold only those rows; «Când se pierde un loc» counts no hidden-list row among the held places, the lapsed ones or the offers; only an Administrator puts a row on the list or takes it off, from the registration's page, each change audited as `registration.outside_capacity_changed` with from and to — the Organizer is refused (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 192 (amended): At 320 pixels the «Lista de invitați speciali» section, its radios' labels and its caption stay inside the screen with no horizontal scroll, and each radio's row is at least 44 pixels tall (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 19 (amended): While an event's «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» is on, or while any real registration on the hidden list holds a place (confirmed or a hold) with the switch off, its places line («N înscriși din M locuri») is followed by «Organizatorii, voluntarii și sportivii invitați pot fi la start în afara locurilor anunțate; ei nu ocupă din aceste locuri.» (English likewise) in every state that draws the line; with the switch off and nobody on the list holding a place, or on an uncapped event, nothing; no string of a public catalogue namespace (anything but `Admin` and `Feedback`) says «lista ascunsă», «invitați speciali», «invitat special», "hidden list" or "special guest" (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 21 (amended): A registration on «Lista de invitați speciali» (the special guests list, `registrations.outside_capacity`) is in no term of the capacity formula in any state — confirmed, a declaration hold, an open offer or a family's reservation; the allocator gives it a place directly whatever the counts and never waitlists or refuses it for want of one, `fillAvailableSpots` never offers it anything and no stale-hold sweep releases its hold for somebody waiting; every change of list serves the line first under the event lock (`fillAvailableSpots` after the stale holds expire, even when the press changes nothing), putting a row that holds a counted place on the list releases that place and the ordinary refill follows, putting a `WAITLISTED` row, or a `WAITLIST_OFFERED` one, on the list gives it a declaration hold at once with the ordinary deadline and one `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` queued (an offer's queued email never tried withdrawn), so past the offer's deadline `expireStaleHolds` leaves it `PENDING_DECLARATION` and `findEventsNeedingMaintenance` does not select its event for it — `WAITLISTED` and `WAITLIST_OFFERED -> PENDING_DECLARATION` only for a hidden-list row, and taking off the list a row that would hold a counted place is refused with `NoFreePlaceError` unless `occupied < capacity` once the line is served — so a hold released for a waiting runner is offered to them, never taken by the row taken off — so two connections racing for the last place while a row comes off the list never end above capacity; a cancelled or expired hidden-list row restarted through the form comes back counted, the mark cleared and journalled; only the column is a condition, `kind` none (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 25 (amended): A registration on the hidden list (`registrations.outside_capacity`) stays out of every term of the capacity formula whatever the event's «Folosește lista de invitați speciali», «Numără și invitații speciali» and «Arată public numărătoarea» say: the free places, the places line and the waiting list's turn never count it (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 30 (amended): A confirmed registration on «Lista de invitați speciali» whose person ticked the list appears in the table like any ticked confirmed runner, with no public marker; unless the event counts the hidden list («Numără și invitații speciali» with «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» on) it is left out of «Cine vine (N)», the «N confirmați — M cu numele afișat» line and the in-progress count, and it is always left out of the places line; an unticked one is not even a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row; while the numbers are said and such a row is in the table, the note under it adds «Cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate (organizatori, voluntari, sportivi invitați) apar în tabel fără să fie numărați: numerele de mai sus numără locurile.» when the hidden list is not counted, and «Numerele de mai sus îi numără și pe cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate (organizatori, voluntari, sportivi invitați); dintre ei, în tabel apar doar cei care au ales să apară.» when it is; the disclosure gates are unchanged (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 31 (amended): The «Lista de invitați speciali» group's three settings, under a heading with the incognito glyph and a switch whose «?» says who the list is for, the two settings under it and how it differs from an invitation by email, are saved by one marker and «Arată public numărătoarea» by its own (a form without a marker edits none of its fields), the group's audited as `event.hidden_list_changed` and the count's tick as `event.participant_count_public_changed`, each naming only what moved, carried by a scoped series save, «Repetă evenimentul» and a duplicate, and carried by the editor's preview; the two under the switch are shown only while it is ticked, and «Arată public numărătoarea» is shown on every event beside «Arată public câți așteaptă»; the editor's summaries call a public participant list that is off «listă nepublică» and «Nepublică», never «lista ascunsă» or «invitați speciali» (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 32 (amended): «Cine vine» shows the same rows whatever the ticks say; with «Numără și invitații speciali» on and the switch on, its title and «confirmați» count every real hidden-list registration with a place (holds among «în curs de confirmare» on a capped event only), the not-counted note is gone and the note says instead that the numbers count them too and that only those who chose to appear are in the table; with «Arată public numărătoarea» off — on any event, the hidden list on or off — it shows no number in the title, no counted line, no «în curs» words and no position column; the places line and the free places never count the hidden list; with the switch off the hidden list is never counted; no rendering of it says «lista ascunsă», «invitați speciali», «invitat special», "hidden list" or "special guest" (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 33 (amended): With «Numără și invitații speciali» on, the note that the numbers count people the table does not show appears only when the numbers above it include somebody on the hidden list: its confirmed, or its holds only where the headline adds them (a capped event's known counts); on an uncapped event a hidden-list hold alone brings no such note (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 36 (amended): A declaration link minted for a registration that holds a declaration replaces that registration's live waiting-list offer link: the offer link is refused as `SUPERSEDED`, its `superseded_by_token_id` names the declaration link and its page says a newer email has the working link, so an open offer put on «Lista de invitați speciali» leaves one working link to sign with (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 23 (amended): «Dă-i un loc acum» on a registration on «Lista de invitați speciali» gives it its place whatever the counts — it needs no counted free place, so a full event does not refuse it and no lapsed declaration hold goes for it — while a counted row on the same full event is still refused with §589's sentence (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 24 (amended): Choosing «Invitat special — nu ocupă un loc» for a waiting row or an open offer opens the «Pui înscrierea pe lista de invitați speciali?» dialog, which names the declaration's email «{message}» and the bold email line for a real row, and for a TEST row neither — its body names the declaration to sign and no email (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 28 (amended): «Retrimite» with days typed never moves the deadline of an invitation that holds a counted place while anyone eligible waits: under the event lock it re-issues the link and the email and keeps the deadline, the dialog says so before the press, the result says the deadline was kept and the audit row records it; an invitation «Pe lista de invitați speciali», and one with nobody waiting, may still be moved later (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §647, §NNN).

Criterion 29 (amended): A send of invitations «Pe lista de invitați speciali» to an event whose «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» is off is refused under the event lock with `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF` — the registration page's own sentence — before any invitation is written or any email queued, and the invitation form draws the tick only while the switch is on; the same send goes through once the switch is on (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §647, §NNN).

Criterion 30 (amended): «Lista de invitați speciali» on a registration's page is two radios, «Se numără între locurile evenimentului» and «Invitat special — nu ocupă un loc», the stored state checked, under a heading with the incognito glyph and, beside it, a 44-pixel «i» whose three lines say who the list is for, what the person keeps and that an ordinary participant does not go there, a one-line caption under the radios, drawn while the event's «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» is on or for a row already on the list — then with the line «Lista de invitați speciali e oprită la acest eveniment: înscrierea poate doar ieși de pe ea.»; the Administrator's form posts the hidden `outside` value opposite to the stored state, a change opens the existing per-state dialog, «Da» posts it to `setOutsideCapacityAction`, «Anulează» sends nothing and shows the stored state again, and the Organizer sees both radios disabled, with no form (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 10 (amended): Given an event, when a registration is confirmed or the batch runs, then it is given the lowest free race number in its own series — the race's, from the event's own `bib_start_number` (1 by default), or, for a row on «Lista de invitați speciali» of an event whose switch is on and whose hidden list has its own series (`hidden_list_bib_start`), the hidden list's, from that start; the race's series ends at the number before the hidden start when that sits above it, and the hidden list's at the number before `bib_start_number` when it sits below it — in order, never at random, the desk's spares and retired numbers skipped; a series with no free number left takes the next free number after it, in the other series if need be, never a duplicate; under the same event-row lock capacity uses; a number once given is never renumbered, stays when the row changes list, and a cancelled registration keeps it (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 30 (amended): Three registrations confirmed in a different order than they were sent are numbered in the order of confirmation, from the first number of their own series — the event's own first number, or, for rows on «Lista de invitați speciali» of an event with the hidden list's own series, that series' first number (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 44 (amended): The event save refuses a hidden-list start inside the race's capped series (`bib_start_number` to `bib_start_number + capacity − 1`), or at or above the race's first number on an uncapped event, naming «Numerele invitaților speciali încep de la», and one whose series (from the start to the race's first number less one when it sits below it, otherwise to the ceiling) would hold any of the desk's reserved spares — a start below spares that sit above the race as well as one inside them — naming the same box (`fields: ["event.hiddenListBibStart"]`), the spares read from the event row locked inside the save's transaction (on an uncapped event too); it judges neither while the switch is off, and judges only a save that moves the hidden start, switches «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» on, or moves the race's first number or its places, and every new event — a save posting all of them as stored passes, so a place «Trimite-i oferta» added (§642) that carries the race's series up to a hidden start set just above it (race 1–150, hidden 151, capacity now 151) never refuses the event's next ordinary save, while a save moving the places to 152 is refused; a scoped series save judges every other date it reaches the same way, against that date's own row — its places and its spares, read from that date's row locked inside the save's transaction — and a refusal names the date and writes nothing on any date; a duplicate and «Repetă evenimentul» judge the band on the source's values and refuse before writing anything or storing the rule, while the maintenance job skips such a source and goes on with the others (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 45 (amended): A refused hidden-list start reaches the Administrator as its own sentence, never «Verifică datele introduse»: `Admin.errors.HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES` (inside the race's series, or its places have reached it) or `HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES` (through the desk's spares), each naming «Numerele invitaților speciali încep de la» / «The special guests' numbers start at» — on the editor's save, with the box linked, on «Repetă evenimentul», with no box linked, and on the events list after a refused duplicate; a scoped series save refused on another date's places or spares answers `HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES_DATED` or `HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES_DATED` with `{date}` that date in the reader's language, while a copy's sentence names no date (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 47 (amended): With the hidden list's series above the race's, the desk's spares stay below it: the first print reserves after the highest number below the hidden start — invitations holding 900–902 never push the spares to 903 — no print or extension reaches the hidden start, both series' draws skip the spares, and a print with no room left before it is refused with `SPARES_BEFORE_HIDDEN_LIST`, whose sentence names «Numerele invitaților speciali încep de la»; a hidden series below the race's bounds nothing (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 68 (amended): /admin/emails foresees no offer to the next in line and no lapse email at the deadline of a declaration hold on «Lista de invitați speciali», which the maintenance job never releases for anybody, and keeps that row's own last call as foreseen (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

Criterion 114 (amended): Putting a registration on the hidden list of an event whose «Folosește lista de invitați speciali» (`events.hidden_list_enabled`, off by default, switched on by migration 0126 for every event already holding such a row) is off is refused under the event lock with `VALIDATION_ERROR` carrying `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`, whose sentence names the switch, and changes nothing; taking one off is allowed whatever the switch says (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §648, §NNN).

The registration page's «Lista de invitați speciali» block explains itself to every role that reads it: the heading's «i» (`InfoTip`, a 44-pixel button beside the heading, outside the radio group's name) holds three lines — «Pentru organizatori, voluntari, pacemakeri și sportivi invitați: sunt la start fără să ocupe unul dintre locurile anunțate.», what they keep and when the public count includes them, and «Un participant obișnuit nu se pune aici.» — and the caption under the radios says it in one line, each under 200 characters, in both languages (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The guide's task «Invitați speciali: organizatori, pacemakeri, voluntari» / «Special guests: organizers, pacemakers, volunteers» opens with a step that says who the list is for, that it is not for an ordinary participant and that it hides nobody, and every step quotes the screen's new words (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Lista de invitați speciali»: the hidden list renamed and explained on every screen
